//: Mixpanel project ids -- the only field the code reads -- plus, for reference, the view and board ids of each project's LangTech Metrics board. Not secrets, so they live here rather than in .env; .env holds only the service-account user and secret.
//1: Read these off a Mixpanel URL: mixpanel.com/project/<projectId>/view/<viewId>/app/boards#id=<boardId>
//2: Env vars MIXPANEL_PROJECT_ID_* still override these, for a one-off run against a different project.

bloomEditor.note: Events carry Language1Iso639Code (not contentLang) and no host, so the 'all' bucket applies. Every event also carries a `channel` property (Release/Beta/Alpha) -- we do NOT currently filter on it; confirm whether the LangTech reports are release-only.

bloomReaderRelease.note: host is either absent or 'bloomreader' -- both are Bloom Reader, so the 'all' bucket applies. Carries contentLang.

bloomLibrary.note: Holds both bloomlibrary.org and BloomPUB Viewer traffic; the two are separated by the bucket breakdown.
